topic: Country with the most physicians per person: Cuba — about 9.5 physicians per 1,000 people (World Bank WDI / WHO, data year 2021), the highest in the world; Germany ≈ 4.5 (2022), United States ≈ 3.7 (2022). ONEI (Cuban statistics office) counts fell from 106,131 physicians in 2021 to 94,066 (2022), 80,763 (2023) and 75,364 (2024) on an island of ~11 million; about 37,000 Cuban doctors worked abroad in 2023 and medical services are Cuba's largest source of foreign income.
